summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2D.3 -- HATP Principal/Signer Enrollment Contract Repair Independent Verification. FINAL DISPOSITION: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- HPSE-001 v1.1 CONTRACT REPAIR COMPLETE. Read-only independent contract verification; zero Dell mutation, zero production .py bytes modified. Did not trust Phase 149O.20L.7O.2D.2's own phase report, companion tests, closure assertions, or architecture prose. Independently re-derived both former Blocking findings from primary source, read fresh this session, before consulting HPSE-001 v1.1's own text: B-149O.20L.7O.2D.1-1 confirmed real by reading hatp_hardware_credentials.py directly (a read-only lookup module exposing no enroll/register/revoke method, whose own docstring defers enrollment to a future administrative surface) and confirmed structurally closed -- not prose disclosure alone -- by HPSE-REQ-056/HPI-7, a live, checked-under-lock precondition a conformant writer cannot bypass. B-149O.20L.7O.2D.1-2 confirmed real by reading Fido2HardwareProvider.credential_identity() and PivHardwareProvider.credential_identity() directly (both method bodies are a single unconditional raise, no branch on device presence, mechanically re-verified by a new test asserting no 'if ' appears in either body) and confirmed closed by the revised HPSE-REQ-011 plus HPSE-REQ-059/060/064. Independently proved HPSE-REQ-057's lock-acquisition ordering (hardware-credential-store lock outer, .deployment-binding-transition.lock inner) is deadlock-free by standard lock-ordering argument, contingent on a continuous-hold reading of the lock through enroll_signer's full check-then-write critical section -- which this phase found is established only by cross-reading HPSE-REQ-057 against HPSE-REQ-058(C)'s literal 'structurally unreachable' claim, not by one self-contained explicit sentence (NBF-1, Non-Blocking). Attacked all six named partial-failure cases (HPSE-REQ-058) individually; each receives an exact, non-overlapping, fail-closed classification. Verified the composite implementation-readiness gate (HPSE-REQ-072) is sufficient and jointly necessary, independently checking that none of its five conditions subsumes another. Reached an independent HHCE-001 disposition verdict of (A) -- sufficiently defined as a named prerequisite interface, not merely named -- because HPSE-REQ-054 already bounds nearly every architectural decision HPSE-001's own correctness depends on (data model, atomicity idiom, lock scope/ordering, audit discipline, the precondition its writer's output must satisfy), leaving HHCE-001 free to vary only in details HPSE-001 itself does not depend on; this means HHCE-001's own contract may safely be authored next without a further HPSE-001 repair cycle. Mechanically reconfirmed HPSE-REQ-001 through HPSE-REQ-074 exactly sequential, no gaps, no duplicates, exactly three (011/045/046) marked revised in place. Independently confirmed via git diff --stat that 7O.2D.2 touched zero files under src/pcae/ or scripts/, and confirmed via grep that no HHCE-001 writer, enroll_signer, or enroll_principal function exists anywhere in src/ or scripts/. Independently confirmed HBDC-001's own 'Depends on' header line still literally reads 'HPSE-001 v1.0' -- disclosed stale (NB-5), not repaired, consistent with the explicit instruction not to bump HBDC-001 without a substantive text change. Recorded two new Non-Blocking findings: NBF-1 (lock continuous-hold-through-critical-section, above) and NBF-2 (HPSE-REQ-054 does not yet explicitly name a HardwareCredentialRecord revocation-timestamp field/grammar requirement, deferred as HHCE-001's own future scope). Neither finding blocks HPSE-001 v1.1's own closure of B-1/B-2, and neither is live-exploitable given current zero-implementation production state. 19 new tests added in tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7o_2d_3_hatp_principal_signer_enrollment_contract_repair_independent_verification.py, all passing, mechanically re-verifying requirement numbering, no-writer-exists claims, the cross-registry precondition text, runtime neutrality, and phase-report self-consistency. Recommended next: 149O.20L.7O.2E -- HATP Trust-Enrollment Implementation Capability (bundled implementation chapter, per the speed-oriented strategic principle, followed by one strong independent implementation verification -- HHCE-001 contract authoring itself must still precede coding). See docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7O_2D_3_HATP_PRINCIPAL_SIGNER_ENROLLMENT_CONTRACT_REPAIR_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md for full detail.
